weights.preferred_access: gated; not required for the stock-voice smoke path

generation.determinism: Stochastic flow sampling uses PyTorch RNG. Call torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each generation; identical output is only claimed for the fully pinned environment on the same supported platform.
generation.streaming: The official iterator yields decoded one-dimensional audio tensors as soon as Mimi frames are ready. Measure API start to first yielded tensor; do not substitute file-write latency.
generation.persistent_voice_state: Supported. get_state_for_audio_prompt('alba') returns a reusable precomputed state; generate with copy_state=true to retain it. Multiple independently named states may remain resident for later turn-by-turn composition.
generation.thread_safety: A TTSModel instance is not thread-safe. Use separate instances for concurrent generation.
